recognize_zh: 這是經下頷骨與口咽層級的軸切增強 CT：左頸部有大型分葉狀、中心密度較低的軟組織腫塊（融合的腫大淋巴結）壓迫周邊構造，對側也有較小淋巴結；年輕病人無痛性雙側大量頸部淋巴結腫大是 Rosai-Dorfman 病（SHML）的典型臨床表現，但影像無法確診。
features: Axial contrast-enhanced CT of the neck at the level of the mandible and oropharynx
Large lobulated soft-tissue mass in the left neck with a lower-attenuation central area, consistent with conglomerate enlarged lymph nodes
Additional enlarged left submandibular node and smaller right cervical nodes
Mass effect on adjacent soft tissues with preserved airway lumen
describe_en: Axial contrast-enhanced CT of the neck at the level of the mandible shows a large, lobulated soft-tissue mass in the left cervical region with a heterogeneous, lower-attenuation central area, consistent with conglomerate enlarged lymph nodes, together with an enlarged left submandibular node and smaller right cervical nodes. The mass displaces adjacent soft tissues while the airway remains patent. Massive painless cervical lymphadenopathy is the classic presentation of sinus histiocytosis with massive lymphadenopathy (Rosai-Dorfman disease), but the imaging appearance is nonspecific and overlaps with lymphoma and infection; diagnosis requires biopsy showing S100-positive histiocytes with emperipolesis.
